reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing exported getScheduledAmount and routes the five inline midpoint copies to it.

duplication.why: Removes the inline copies of the ranged-amount computation rather than editing each, leaving one definition.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, already consumed by both server and client code.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, the parameter type widening for null and targeted tests.

maintainability.why: A future change to the expected amount is a one-line edit in one function with unit tests covering both orders and signs.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions now call it, as did the client components
